Vehicle details you enter, mileage, maintenance, fuel and check records, attached photos and receipts, album photos and notes, and app settings. Everything stays on this device. An account is optional. Car sounds you record for a record also stay on this device, and the microphone permission is asked only when you first tap record.

Your vehicle details and records are not sent to Chageun. If you sign up for a Chageun account (email or Google), your email and a Firebase user ID are kept by Google Firebase. If you sign in with Google, your Google account name and profile photo address are kept there too, as is any name you set yourself. The name and photo are shown on Home and the Account screen; the photo file is stored on this device only and removed when you sign out. If you turn on Google Drive backup, the backup file (records, photos, recorded sounds and album, with the plate number masked) is saved to a hidden app folder in your own Google Drive; Chageun\'s operator cannot access it, and it uses your Drive storage. Dashboard photos, car cut-outs and receipt text recognition are processed on the device only. To improve the app, usage events such as “a fuel record was saved” are sent to Google Firebase Analytics without your plate number, record details, questions, email or advertising ID. If the app crashes, the error details and device model are sent to Google Firebase Crashlytics. You can turn both off in Settings › Privacy. To show ads, the Google Mobile Ads SDK contacts Google and may use your device\'s advertising ID, depending on your consent. When you ask an external AI, you see the exact text first and choose the app to share it with. Plate number, owner and location are never included.

The plate number is encrypted with a key kept in the Android Keystore and is shown masked. Location and camera details are removed from photos when they are attached. App data is not included in Android\'s automatic backup or device transfer; it leaves the device only as a ZIP file you export or a Google Drive backup you turn on.

Settings › Data lets you export everything to a ZIP file, send it to another device, restore it, or delete it all, and turn Google Drive backup on or off. Settings › Account lets you delete your account, which removes your email and user ID. Google Drive backups stay in your Drive; delete them in Google Drive › Settings › Manage apps. Uninstalling the app removes the data on this device.

Maintenance intervals are general recommendations, not manufacturer values, unless you changed them. Answers from external AI apps can be wrong. Follow your owner\'s manual and a qualified mechanic for safety decisions.

Chageun is a personal car care tool that works out maintenance timing from the records you enter and reminds you. It doesn\'t diagnose your car or replace a mechanic\'s inspection.

Unless you changed them, replacement intervals are general recommendations, not the manufacturer\'s official values. Remaining distance and dates are estimated from your records and average driving, so they can differ from your car\'s actual condition. If something feels wrong with safety parts like brakes or tires, get them checked right away, whatever the app shows.

Ask AI sends a summary to the external AI app you choose. That service writes the answer, and it can be wrong. Chageun doesn\'t review or guarantee AI answers. Check what will be sent before you share it.

Recall checks and inspection booking open sites run by public bodies such as the Korea Automobile Recall Center and the Korea Transportation Safety Authority. Those bodies provide and manage that information and those services. The inspection due date is the one you entered, so compare it with your official notice.
Records are stored on this device. If you lose the device or delete the app, they\'re gone too, so keep a copy with Export or Google Drive backup in Settings › Data.

Weather on Home is optional. When you choose your current location, Chageun asks for approximate location permission only then, rounds the location to about 10 km and sends it to MET Norway (the Norwegian Meteorological Institute) to get the weather. If you pick a region instead (down to a neighborhood), only that region\'s representative point, rounded to about 1 km, is sent. Chageun doesn\'t store or log your location, and the weather is kept in memory for about an hour. With your current location, the same rounded location is used to look up the area name (city and district only, like \"Gangnam-gu, Seoul\") through your device\'s geocoding service (usually Google Play services), which may receive the rounded location. The area name is saved only on your device so it shows right away next time, and it\'s removed when you turn weather off, change the location or delete all data. You can turn weather off or change the location in Settings › Weather.
